basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for vibrant colors and sound design. I spend my weekends experimenting with hair colors and playing my electric guitar. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for anime and gaming. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during lunch breaks. My job allows me to work remotely, so I often have a flexible schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been dyeing my hair for over five years, learning through trial and error and various online tutorials. My design background enhances my color theory skills, which I apply to both my work and personal style. I'm also an active member of several gaming communities, contributing insights based on years of casual and competitive play.
